department: Environmental Sciences Graduate Program (Beck College of Science and Mathematics)

deadline.value: Recommended Fall application deadline of February 15, 2027 (Spring deadline July 15; the standalone program webpage also notes a recommended January 15 Fall date in its checklist and September 15 for Spring).
deadline.quote: Applicants are encouraged to submit the application no later than February 15th for the fall semester and July 15th for the spring semester.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are required per the 2026-2027 Graduate Bulletin and Ph.D. program webpage (recommended minimum 150 Verbal and 150 Quantitative); note that A-State's International Graduate Admissions chart lists 'No' for GRE under Environmental Sciences.
gre_general.quote: Scores from the Graduate Record Examination are required. A score of 150 on both the verbal and quantitative tests are recommended for acceptance.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Environmental Sciences (Subject Tests exist only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact Environmental Sciences faculty beforehand and must identify potential advisor candidates in their statement of purpose; the 2026-2027 Graduate Bulletin sets Doctoral Advisory Committee chair selection during the first year, though the program webpage checklist mentions a sponsoring graduate faculty member.
supervisor.quote: Applicants should also contact faculty they would like to work with and describe in the statement of purpose what faculty member would be a good candidate to be their advisor.

also.quote: A sponsoring graduate faculty member within Arkansas State University.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships are awarded competitively to a limited number of qualified applicants across departments; full doctoral graduate assistantships include an out-of-state tuition waiver and an in-state tuition fellowship (up to 10 semesters).
funding.quote: Doctoral graduate assistantship carries a tuition fellowship covering the cost of tuition.

also.quote: Doctoral graduate assistants also have in-state tuition covered by the university or their program.

entry_route.value: Minimum of a bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in a relevant field, with a master's degree preferred; 72 graduate credits beyond the bachelor's or 42 beyond the master's are required (with an en route M.S. available upon candidacy).
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the PhD Graduate Program in Environmental Sciences Program must hold a baccalaureate degree (BA, BS) and preferably a master’s degree (MA, MS) from an accredited institution in a relevant field of study.

notes: Interdisciplinary Ph.D. in Environmental Sciences spanning environmental chemistry/soil and water science, environmental policy/law/economics, and ecological/biosciences research; en route M.S. available upon Ph.D. candidacy.
name: Ph.D. in Environmental Sciences
